## KHUSHAL DHANANI

## Web Designer

## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

- UI Designer, seeking to use proven skills in UI prototyping to enhance user experience.
- Extensive experience in creating initial application concepts and solutions using wireframes and rapid to high fidelity prototypes, integrating user-centered design, technologies, and business strategy.
- 3+ years of working experience in different segments of the IT industry.
- Create a site map, user flows, wireframes, page layouts, and UI specification deliverables for hand-off to technology and QA.
- Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical individuals at all levels.
- Experienced Front End Web Design offers 3+ years of expertise in Web Application Design using ReactJS, Next-Js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (Basic), and Bootstrap.
- Experience in software development with a focus on requirements gathering, product release, planning and estimation, design, documentation, architecting, and development.
- 1+ years of experience in leading a team of 2 to 3 members.
- Experience with version control system bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab.
- Experience in initiating a project from scratch.
- Quick learner of new technologies.

## TECHNICAL SKILLS

Design Tools

Adobe Xd, Adobe Photoshop, Figma, and other

designing tools.

Libraries & Frameworks

ReactJS, Nextjs

UI Libraries

Bootstrap, AntD, Material UI, Tailwind CSS

VCS

Git

## WORK HISTORY

## KNOVATOR TECHNOLOGIES

## UI UX DESIGNER SEP 2020 - PRESENT

- The first one is prototyping and designing new mechanics for the online platform, transferring the high fidelity design to development and testing it after release. Also, convert into Html CSS Design using NextJs with Tailwindcss.
- Involving in Project Management and Development.

## STRING ERP

- Project Highlights One textile ERP software for efficient resource planning and management.
- Create a product app design and web design from scratch using Adobe XD.
- Design conversation Using Next Js.
- Involved in the development of static Websites.

## SHADOW SIGHT

- Project Highlights: Security Management Software.
- Create an Admin panel design from scratch using XD.
- Converting XD design in NextJs with Tailwindcss.

## HK ANALYTICS

- Project Highlights Diamond Tender Management System.
- Work on Design development in Next Js.

## ORBIT JOBS

- Project Highlights Job Portal.
- Create a web app and Mobile app design.
- Create an orbit jobs website.

## SPARROW HEALTH / WONDER MD HEALTH

- Project Highlights Old age health platform / Children disease Consulting Platform.
- Create a High Fidelity UI design.
- Work on frontend side development in Next Js.

## SNAPCRACK CHIROPRACTIC

- Project Highlights Chiropractic Health service.
- Work on frontend side Design Modification in Next Js.

## AFRICA BUSINESS CONSOLE

- Project Highlights An online platform to scale your business into thriving African markets.
- Create a High Fidelity UI design.
- Work on frontend side Design Modification in Next Js.
- Here, I worked as UI UX Designer Creating a web & app design Working on different tools like Adobe Xd, Figma, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe Illustrator.
- Also, create a website from scratch Using
- HTML5/CSS3
- jQuery
- Bootstrap
- LESS/SASS
- Mobile Responsive
- Creating Email templates Design.
- Involved in the development of static Websites.
- working with browser compatibility issues.
- working on component-based design systems.

## CREDENCE TECHNOLOGIES

## Web DESIGNER           SEP 2019 - AUG 2020

## EDUCATION

Diploma (INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY)

Parul University, Vadodara (Gujarat)

2015 TO 2017
